reports.desc: Fake transaction showed up on my Shop account for $339.96 for a PC protection plan that I did not purchase in an attempt to get me to call the phone number listed in the address: 1-888-527-7789 and steal personal details and access my device.

I thought i was purchasing clothing items (6 total, 3 per order).  I waited a week and never got a shipping notice and still haven't gotten one for either order. I have emailed them multiple times and i just get multiple excuses.

Received message (see attached) on personal smart phone. I called the number and told the person who answered I needed to speak to someone about a charge I didn't make. That person started asking me about what types of devices I use to access SHOP, which I thought was unusual and not needed to resolve the disputed charge. Initially I tried to answer some of the questions, but then I said, "This information isn't needed. Are you going to remove this charge?" The male answered that I had reached SHOP Customer Service and they needed me to not use my SHOP account for 24 hours. While talking to this individual, I googled the phone number and saw that it had come up as a SCAM, so I immediately hung up. The SHOP charge has not yet hit my bank account. In SHOP, it currently has a message that says "Waiting for details". I will attempt to update this report later if this status changes and let you know if the charge is deducted from my bank account.

I was tracking down why I got a receipt from Kohls.  I looked up telephone number online 855.564.5705 and the person (with a strong accent) told me I needed to call 888-647-1712 to talk to the credit card people.  They asked for my SSN - I said no-
they asked for birthday.  - they then said they had my information from Pottery Barn.  That card is very old and was cancelled.  Made me realize I was probably scammed.

Freecash is a website where you play mobile games to get money. There were games where I spent my money with the intention of completing higher levels to get higher rewards. Freecash let's you do this while taking your info and when you get high enough they ban your account so you can't withdraw your rewards. I did not do anything to violate any TOS.
I looked up a number for Utube tv online and the number listed was 877-496-9399 and it merely a scam trying to obtain account numbers and bank information.
Advertisement of 10 pair double button mid waist jeans for $29.99 plus tax and shipping. Tracking information made no sense and upon trying to make contact i have received no response.

I got a number for Utube tv from google for tech support. The call was answered by someone sounding like from India. She advised me that they had no payment method on file. She was able to take over my screen and creat several PayPal debit cards. I was able to contact PayPal and advise them of the potential scam.

It’s name is Sezzle. . They fraudulently took money out of my bank account. And then after doing a fraud investigation through their own company, they refuse to return my money, even though I have a report with the FTC and an identity theft report.

My UnitedHealthcare (UHC) insurance information appears to have been compromised and used to submit a claim for four different services that I did not receive. While I did not incur any out-of-pocket expenses or make any payments, my insurance plan was billed and paid 100% of the charges associated with these claims.
I am reporting this as potential insurance fraud.
Got a job offer for a company I cannot find any history or information on
I have a product that carries a 365-day Warranty, it's not working and the company will not take back

I believe I've fallen for a scam I saw on Facebook.  There was a testemonial from a woman whose sister died of liver failure, & she shared info about Purelia.  Talking with others & now looking up reviews, I see that the same story has been copied & pasted, & the names changed.  I only ordered yesterday so there's a chance I'll receive the supplement in the mail, but now that I've had a day to think about it, I'm thinking the product might not be legitimate & I'm wondering if the BBB could investigate.
Thank you!
Voice mail message said I was preapproved for up to $50,000 for the alternative debt hardship programs that "went to affect July 1st, 2026" and I should call back at 833-333-7511.

Called said I took out a loan with VIP in 2021 which I never I never heard of a company called VIP. Guy said they will filed a case in court but didn’t provide me with a case number just demanded money when I said I never had loan with them he said I’ll see you in court
